title: The Office - Presentation Series 9 - Summary and Conclusion
audio: mp3/295. The Office - Presentation Series 9 - Summary and Conclusion.mp3

segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod. My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 Englishpod。 我的名字是马可。

segments.en: My name is Katherine and here today we have almost, almost to the end of our series on giving a presentation in English.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们几乎到了我们关于用英语进行演示的系列的结尾。

segments.en: This is part 9 of 10, so this is near the end.
segments.zh: 这是 10 的第 9 部分，所以这是接近尾声。

segments.en: But we've got a lot of really great words and phrases for discussing what you've talked about in the last, I don't know, 10 minutes or so.
segments.zh: 但是我们有很多非常棒的单词和短语来讨论你上次讨论的内容，我不知道，10 分钟左右。

segments.en: It's the summary of your speech and so that's what we're going to talk about today.
segments.zh: 这是你演讲的总结，所以这就是我们今天要讨论的内容。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So let's take a look at what Mr. Ford is saying in his summary and we'll be back in a bit.
segments.zh: 所以让我们来看看福特先生在他的总结中所说的话，我们稍后会回来的。

segments.en: Right everyone.
segments.zh: 对了大家。

segments.en: I apologize that I can't show you the marketing campaign today, but next week you will all have the opportunity to see it for yourselves.
segments.zh: 很抱歉，我今天不能向您展示营销活动，但下周你们将有机会亲眼看到它。

segments.en: And I have no doubt that you will be impressed.
segments.zh: 我毫不怀疑你会印象深刻。

segments.en: Let me wrap up the presentation by summarizing my key points.
segments.zh: 让我通过总结我的关键点来结束演示文稿。

segments.en: As I mentioned at the outset, 2010 represents a key year for Alpha Computers.
segments.zh: 正如我一开始提到的，2010 年代表了 Alpha Computers 的关键年份。

segments.en: The recession is hopefully behind us.
segments.zh: 希望经济衰退已经过去了。

segments.en: It is clear to everyone in the computer industry that demand is booming, especially in the developing markets.
segments.zh: 计算机行业的每个人都清楚，需求正在蓬勃发展，尤其是在发展中市场。

segments.en: If we are to succeed in this ultra-competitive field then we really need to push forward and offer our customers products that meet their needs on all levels.
segments.zh: 如果我们要在这个竞争激烈的领域取得成功，那么我们真的需要推动并为我们的客户提供满足他们各个层面需求的产品。

segments.en: As I hope I've illustrated, the X420 represents the kind of computer that can really satisfy those needs.
segments.zh: 正如我希望我已经说明的那样，X420 代表了一种真正满足这些需求的计算机。

segments.en: I gave you an idea of the kind of revenue we expect to hit in 2010 with the new X420 range and believe me, this is really just the beginning.
segments.zh: 我让您了解我们预计在 2010 年新的 X420 系列将达到的收入类型，相信我，这真的只是一个开始。

segments.en: Once we establish the X420 in the market, we have plans to continue to expand our range with ever more revolutionary and impressive products.
segments.zh: 一旦我们在市场上建立了 X420，我们就计划继续以更具革命性和令人印象深刻的产品扩大我们的范围。

segments.en: Alpha Computers is dedicated to innovation and improvement.
segments.zh: Alpha Computers 致力于创新和改进。

segments.en: I really see no limit in our potential as long as we stick to the principles I stressed earlier.
segments.zh: 只要我们坚持我之前强调的原则，我真的认为我们的潜力没有限制。

segments.en: Quality, excellence, and service.
segments.zh: 质量、卓越和服务。

segments.en: Before we move on to the Q&A section, I'd really like to leave you with a quote that really sums up everything that we've discussed today and hopefully it will provide you with the same inspiration that it gives me.
segments.zh: 进入问答环节之前，我想送给大家一句话，它概括了我们今天讨论的全部内容。希望它也能像激励我一样，给大家带来启发。

segments.en: As the great Henry Ford once said, quality means doing it right when no one is looking.
segments.zh: 正如伟大的亨利·福特曾说过的：“品质，就是在没人监督时也把事情做好。”

segments.en: Well, in fact our customers are looking. They are looking for us to lead the way and to give them the quality that our competitors cannot.
segments.zh: 事实上，我们的顾客正在关注着我们。他们期待我们引领潮流，提供竞争对手无法企及的品质。

segments.en: We cannot let them down.
segments.zh: 我们不能让他们失望。

segments.en: All right, we're back. So now let's take a look at some language on Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们回来了。 所以现在让我们来看看语言外卖的一些语言。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: So, Marco, at the very beginning of today's monologue, we have a phrase that basically means the same thing as summarize.
segments.zh: 所以，Marco，在今天的独白的开头，我们有一个短语，基本上与总结的意思相同。

segments.en: What was that phrase?
segments.zh: 那句话是什么？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: At the last sentence of the first paragraph, we see Mr. Ford say, let me wrap up the presentation by summarizing my key points.
segments.zh: 在第一段的最后一句话中，我们看到福特先生说，让我总结一下我的关键点来结束演示文稿。

segments.en: So the phrase there is wrap up.
segments.zh: 所以那里的短语是总结的。

segments.en: It means to conclude, to finish, to end.
segments.zh: 这意味着总结，结束，结束。

segments.en: This is the very end of his speech and so to wrap something up means to finish it.
segments.zh: 这是他演讲的最后，所以总结一些东西意味着完成它。

segments.en: That's right. So maybe if you're giving a speech and someone is telling you to wrap it up quickly.
segments.zh: 没错。 所以也许如果你在发表演讲，而有人告诉你要尽快结束。

segments.en: That means stop.
segments.zh: 这意味着停止。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Please find an ending point.
segments.zh: 请找到一个终点。

segments.en: So wrap it up.
segments.zh: 所以把它包起来。

segments.en: Let's go.
segments.zh: 我们走吧。

segments.en: Come on.
segments.zh: 来吧。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So he's wrapping it up by summarizing what he has talked about.
segments.zh: 因此，他总结了他所说的内容。

segments.en: And so he goes back to the very beginning and he says, as I mentioned at the outset.
segments.zh: 所以他回到了最开始，他说，正如我一开始提到的那样。

segments.en: Okay, the outset is a noun, it's a time and it means the beginning.
segments.zh: 好的，开头是一个名词，它是一个时间，它意味着开始。

segments.en: So you might remember in parts one or two of this speech that he was talking about why 2010 is an important year for their company.
segments.zh: 所以你可能会记得在这篇演讲的一两个部分中，他在谈论为什么 2010 年对他们的公司来说是重要的一年。

segments.en: And so this is the outset.
segments.zh: 这就是开始。

segments.en: This is the beginning. You can also say at the outset things looked bad but it turns out that they went well.
segments.zh: 这是开始。 你也可以说一开始事情看起来很糟糕，但事实证明它们进展顺利。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So outset means beginning the start of something.
segments.zh: 所以开始意味着开始某事的开始。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And he also talked about how the computer industry demand is booming.
segments.zh: 他还谈到了计算机行业的需求如何蓬勃发展。

segments.en: All right. So booming is an interesting word because boom, the noun means boom, a sound.
segments.zh: 好的。 所以Booming是一个有趣的词，因为BOOM，名词的意思是BOOM，一个声音。

segments.en: To explode.
segments.zh: 爆炸。

segments.en: Right. It's a sound that you hear when there's a storm.
segments.zh: 对。 这是你在暴风雨时听到的声音。

segments.en: But booming means doing very well.
segments.zh: 但蓬勃发展意味着做得很好。

segments.en: That means that in this case demand is booming.
segments.zh: 这意味着在这种情况下，需求正在蓬勃发展。

segments.en: There is a lot of demand.
segments.zh: 有很多需求。

segments.en: That's right. So when you hear people say business is booming.
segments.zh: 没错。 所以当你听到人们说生意正在蓬勃发展。

segments.en: That means business is going very well.
segments.zh: 这意味着业务进展顺利。

segments.en: It's very successful.
segments.zh: 它非常成功。

segments.en: Okay. So it basically means that it's doing very well, that it's growing quickly and rapidly.
segments.zh: 好的。 所以它基本上意味着它做得很好，它正在快速和快速地增长。

segments.en: So he went on to talk about the X420 and how the company has plans to keep expanding and keep coming out with ever more revolutionary and impressive products.
segments.zh: 因此，他继续谈论 X420 以及该公司如何计划不断扩张并不断推出更具革命性和令人印象深刻的产品。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So something is a revolutionary if it changes a situation.
segments.zh: 因此，如果某事改变了局势，它就是革命性的。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Because revolution basically means change but not a small change, a really big change.
segments.zh: 因为革命基本上意味着改变，但不是一个小的变化，一个真正的大变化。

segments.en: And so a product is revolutionary if it introduces something really new, really exciting.
segments.zh: 因此，如果产品引入了真正新的、非常令人兴奋的东西，它将是革命性的。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So an example of a revolutionary product was the home computer.
segments.zh: 因此，革命性产品的一个例子是家用电脑。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Because the home computer changed the way people typed and communicated and did all these different things. And so it's revolutionary because it introduced a big change.
segments.zh: 因为家用电脑改变了人们的打字和交流方式，并做了所有这些不同的事情。 所以它是革命性的，因为它带来了巨大的变化。

segments.en: That's right. Okay.
segments.zh: 没错。 好的。

segments.en: So revolutionary.
segments.zh: 如此革命。

segments.en: Towards the end of Mr. Ford's dialogue, he said that they're going to have a Q&A section and he left us with a quote that according to him sums up everything we've discussed today.
segments.zh: 在福特先生的对话结束时，他说他们将有一个问答部分，他给我们留下了一个引用，据他说，这总结了我们今天讨论的一切。

segments.en: Okay. To sum up.
segments.zh: 好的。 总结一下。

segments.en: This is very related to the word to summarize. It means to say in fewer words. Okay. So this quote says what he wants to say, but it says it in a very short space.
segments.zh: 这与要总结的词非常相关。 这意味着用更少的词来表达。 好的。 所以这句话说了他想说的话，但它在很短的空间里说出来。

segments.en: So if we read a book and I ask you to sum up the story, this is basically I'm asking for a summary.
segments.zh: 因此，如果我们阅读一本书并要求您总结故事，这基本上是我要求总结。

segments.en: That's right. So I could say, you know, the Harry Potter story is a story about a young boy who is a wizard who loses his parents, who goes to school with his friends and learns about his powers.
segments.zh: 没错。 所以我可以说，你知道，哈利波特的故事是一个关于一个巫师失去父母的故事，他和朋友一起上学并了解他的力量。

segments.en: That's a perfect way to sum up the Harry Potter story.
segments.zh: 这是总结哈利波特故事的完美方式。

segments.en: All right. Very good.
segments.zh: 好的。 非常好。

segments.en: So that's about it for language takeaway today, but we have some great phrases coming up for you in Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 这就是今天的语言外卖，但我们有一些很棒的短语为您提供流利的构建器。

segments.en: Let's listen to the dialogue again first and we'll be back in a moment.
segments.zh: 让我们先再听一次对话，我们一会儿回来。

segments.en: Right everyone, I apologize that I can't show you the marketing campaign today, but next week you will all have the opportunity to see it for yourselves.
segments.zh: 对大家，我很抱歉我今天不能向你展示营销活动，但下周你们都有机会亲眼看到它。

segments.en: And I have no doubt that you will be impressed.
segments.zh: 我毫不怀疑你会印象深刻。

segments.en: Let me wrap up the presentation by summarizing my key points.
segments.zh: 让我通过总结我的关键点来结束演示文稿。

segments.en: As I mentioned at the outset, 2010 represents a key year for Alpha Computers.
segments.zh: 正如我一开始提到的，2010 年代表了 Alpha Computers 的关键年份。

segments.en: The recession is hopefully behind us.
segments.zh: 经济衰退希望在我们身后。

segments.en: It is clear to everyone in the computer industry that demand is booming, especially in the developing markets.
segments.zh: 计算机行业的每个人都清楚，需求正在蓬勃发展，尤其是在发展中市场。

segments.en: If we're to succeed in this ultra competitive field, then we really need to push forward and offer our customers products that meet their needs on all levels.
segments.zh: 如果我们要在这个竞争激烈的领域取得成功，那么我们真的需要推动并为我们的客户提供在各个层面满足他们需求的产品。

segments.en: As I hope I've illustrated, the X420 represents the kind of computer that can really satisfy those needs.
segments.zh: 正如我希望我已经说明的那样，X420 代表了一种真正满足这些需求的计算机。

segments.en: I gave you an idea of the kind of revenue we expect to hit in 2010 with the new X420 range, and believe me, this is really just the beginning.
segments.zh: 我让您了解我们预计在 2010 年推出的新 X420 系列的收入类型，相信我，这真的只是一个开始。

segments.en: Once we establish the X420 in the market, we have plans to continue to expand our range with ever more revolutionary and impressive products.
segments.zh: 一旦我们在市场上建立了 X420，我们就计划继续以更具革命性和令人印象深刻的产品扩大我们的范围。

segments.en: Alpha Computers is dedicated to innovation and improvement.
segments.zh: Alpha Computers 致力于创新和改进。

segments.en: I really see no limit in our potential as long as we stick to the principles I stressed earlier, quality, excellence, and service.
segments.zh: 只要我们坚持我之前强调的原则，质量、卓越和服务，我真的认为我们的潜力没有限制。

segments.en: Before we move on to the Q&A section, I'd really like to leave you with a quote that really sums up everything that we've discussed today, and hopefully it will provide you with the same inspiration that it gives me.
segments.zh: 在我们进入问答部分之前，我真的很想给你留下一个真正总结我们今天讨论的一切的报价，希望它能为你提供与我相同的灵感。

segments.en: As the great Henry Ford once said, quality means doing it right when no one is looking.
segments.zh: 正如伟大的亨利·福特曾说过的：“品质，就是在没人监督时也把事情做好。”

segments.en: Well, in fact, our customers are looking.
segments.zh: 好吧，事实上，我们的客户正在寻找。

segments.en: They're looking for us to lead the way and to give them the quality that our competitors cannot.
segments.zh: 他们正在寻找我们引领潮流，并为他们提供我们的竞争对手无法做到的质量。

segments.en: We cannot let them down.
segments.zh: 我们不能让他们失望。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So now let's take a look at four key phrases on Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 所以现在让我们来看看关于 Fluency Builder 的四个关键短语。

segments.en: Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 流利表达。

segments.en: So the first phrase we've got here in Fluency Builder is an interesting one, and I think it's important to point out because we've got a verb and a noun that often go together.
segments.zh: 所以我们在 Fluency Builder 中得到的第一个短语是一个有趣的短语，我认为指出这一点很重要，因为我们有一个动词和一个经常在一起的名词。

segments.en: Mr. Ford said this kind of computer can really satisfy those needs that customers have.
segments.zh: 福特先生说，这种电脑真的可以满足客户的需求。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So the phrase there is to satisfy a need.
segments.zh: 所以那里的短语是为了满足需求。

segments.en: And as you said, this verb and this noun usually go together.
segments.zh: 正如你所说，这个动词和这个名词通常并存。

segments.en: You want to satisfy your customers' needs.
segments.zh: 您想满足客户的需求。

segments.en: All right, so what do I need?
segments.zh: 好吧，那我需要什么？

segments.en: I need a good computer that is fast that I can do my business on. And this computer, the X420, satisfies that need. It does what I need it to do.
segments.zh: 我需要一台速度很快的好电脑，我可以在上面做生意。 而这台电脑，X420，满足了需要。 它完成了我需要它做的事情。

segments.en: Okay, so we understand the verb to satisfy, but the phrase is a very powerful phrase, especially if you use it in business where you're saying we are giving our customers what they need and we are making them happy.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以我们理解动词来满足，但这个短语是一个非常有力的短语，特别是如果你在商业中使用它，你说我们正在为我们的客户提供他们需要的东西，我们正在让他们开心。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Okay. As he continued talking about the X420, he said this is just the beginning.
segments.zh: 好的。 当他继续谈论 X420 时，他说这只是一个开始。

segments.en: All right, so this is something we often say when we have a long project or plan.
segments.zh: 好吧，当我们有一个漫长的项目或计划时，这是我们经常说的话。

segments.en: You can say, yes, things are good now, but this is just the beginning.
segments.zh: 你可以说，是的，现在一切都很好，但这只是一个开始。

segments.en: All right, there are many good things to come.
segments.zh: 好吧，有很多好事要来。

segments.en: And this is something we often say in a positive way.
segments.zh: 这是我们经常以积极的方式说的话。

segments.en: Yes, this is good, but expect better things in the future.
segments.zh: 是的，这很好，但期待未来会发生更好的事情。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: Okay, so this is just the beginning.
segments.zh: 好吧，这只是开始。

segments.en: And well, as he continued talking about the company, he said that the customers are looking for us to lead the way.
segments.zh: 好吧，当他继续谈论公司时，他说客户正在寻找我们引领潮流。

segments.en: Okay, so this is an interesting phrase because he's making a comparison with other companies and he's saying, listen, our customers have many needs, but they want us to really be ahead of them and to innovate and to make new things and new computers that will be ahead of the competition.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以这是一个有趣的短语，因为他正在与其他公司进行比较，他说，听着，我们的客户有很多需求，但他们希望我们真正领先于他们，创新并制造将在竞争中领先的新事物和新计算机。

segments.en: So take the lead, be in the front.
segments.zh: 所以带头，站在前面。

segments.en: So basically the phrase to lead the way is for you to be in the front and give people a clear path.
segments.zh: 所以基本上引导你的短语是让你站在最前面，给人们一条清晰的道路。

segments.en: Think of Usain Bolt, that runner in the Olympics.
segments.zh: 想想奥运会上的赛跑者尤塞恩·博尔特。

segments.en: Everyone's running quickly, but all of a sudden he takes the lead.
segments.zh: 每个人都在快速奔跑，但突然间他取得了领先。

segments.en: He leads the way.
segments.zh: 他带路。

segments.en: He is ahead of everyone else.
segments.zh: 他领先于其他人。

segments.en: All the other runners are far, far behind him.
segments.zh: 所有其他跑步者都远远落后于他。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay, so he's leading the way and he finishes his monologue by saying, we cannot let them down.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以他正在引领潮流，他完成了他的独白，说，我们不能让他们失望。

segments.en: We cannot let our customers down, basically.
segments.zh: 基本上，我们不能让我们的客户失望。

segments.en: So the phrase here is to let someone down.
segments.zh: 所以这里的短语是让某人失望。

segments.en: He let me down.
segments.zh: 他让我失望了。

segments.en: We let them down.
segments.zh: 我们让他们失望了。

segments.en: This is a great phrase and you can use it about anybody.
segments.zh: 这是一个很好的短语，您可以对任何人使用它。

segments.en: And it's a really important phrase because it means to disappoint someone.
segments.zh: 这是一个非常重要的短语，因为它意味着让某人失望。

segments.en: So for example, Marco, when you forgot my birthday, you really let me down.
segments.zh: 例如，马可，当你忘记我的生日时，你真的让我失望了。

segments.en: Okay, so that means I disappointed you because I forgot your birthday. So to let someone down is to disappoint them, to not do what you were expected to do.
segments.zh: 好吧，这意味着我让你失望了，因为我忘记了你的生日。 所以让某人失望就是让他们失望，不要做你期望做的事情。

segments.en: Exactly. And so a company can do this.
segments.zh: 没错。 所以一家公司可以做到这一点。

segments.en: For example, when a company like Toyota makes a car that has many problems, that company lets down its customers.
segments.zh: 例如，当像丰田这样的公司制造出有很多问题的汽车时，该公司会让客户失望。

segments.en: So you can let someone down.
segments.zh: 所以你可以让某人失望。

segments.en: Basically, you have to have the subject.
segments.zh: 基本上，你必须有主题。

segments.en: You let someone down or the company let down its customers.
segments.zh: 你让某人失望或公司让客户失望。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Okay. A lot of great stuff here.
segments.zh: 好的。 这里有很多很棒的东西。

segments.en: Why don't we take one last listen and we'll be back in a bit.
segments.zh: 为什么我们不听最后一听，我们会回来一会儿。

segments.en: Right everyone, I apologize that I can't show you the marketing campaign today, but next week you will all have the opportunity to see it for yourselves.
segments.zh: 对大家，我很抱歉我今天不能向你展示营销活动，但下周你们都有机会亲眼看到它。

segments.en: And I have no doubt that you will be impressed.
segments.zh: 我毫不怀疑你会印象深刻。

segments.en: Let me wrap up the presentation by summarizing my key points.
segments.zh: 让我通过总结我的关键点来结束演示文稿。

segments.en: As I mentioned at the outset, 2010 represents a key year for Alpha Computers.
segments.zh: 正如我一开始提到的，2010 年代表了 Alpha Computers 的关键年份。

segments.en: The recession is hopefully behind us.
segments.zh: 经济衰退希望在我们身后。

segments.en: It is clear to everyone in the computer industry that demand is booming, especially in the developing markets.
segments.zh: 计算机行业的每个人都清楚，需求正在蓬勃发展，尤其是在发展中市场。

segments.en: If we are to succeed in this ultra-competitive field, then we really need to push forward and offer our customers products that meet their needs on all levels.
segments.zh: 如果我们要在这个竞争激烈的领域取得成功，那么我们真的需要推动并为我们的客户提供满足他们各个层面需求的产品。

segments.en: As I hope I've illustrated, the X420 represents the kind of computer that can really satisfy those needs.
segments.zh: 正如我希望我已经说明的那样，X420 代表了一种真正满足这些需求的计算机。

segments.en: I gave you an idea of the kind of revenue we expect to hit in 2010 with the new X420 range, and believe me, this is really just the beginning.
segments.zh: 我让您了解我们预计在 2010 年推出的新 X420 系列的收入类型，相信我，这真的只是一个开始。

segments.en: Once we establish the X420 in the market, we have plans to continue to expand our range with ever more revolutionary and impressive products.
segments.zh: 一旦我们在市场上建立了 X420，我们就计划继续以更具革命性和令人印象深刻的产品扩大我们的范围。

segments.en: Alpha Computers is dedicated to innovation and improvement.
segments.zh: Alpha Computers 致力于创新和改进。

segments.en: I really see no limit in our potential as long as we stick to the principles I stressed earlier, quality, excellence, and service.
segments.zh: 只要我们坚持我之前强调的原则，质量、卓越和服务，我真的认为我们的潜力没有限制。

segments.en: Before we move on to the Q&A section, I'd really like to leave you with a quote that really sums up everything we've discussed today, and hopefully it will provide you with the same inspiration that it gives me.
segments.zh: 在我们进入问答部分之前，我真的很想给你留下一个真正总结我们今天讨论的一切的报价，希望它能为你提供与我相同的灵感。

segments.en: As the great Henry Ford once said, quality means doing it right, when no one is looking.
segments.zh: 正如伟大的亨利福特曾经说过的，当没有人在寻找时，质量意味着做对了。

segments.en: Well, in fact, our customers are looking. They are looking for us to lead the way and to give them the quality that our competitors cannot.
segments.zh: 好吧，事实上，我们的客户正在寻找。 他们正在寻找我们引领潮流，并为他们提供我们竞争对手无法做到的质量。

segments.en: We cannot let them down.
segments.zh: 我们不能让他们失望。

segments.en: Alright guys, so this is the penultimate lesson about presentation skills.
segments.zh: 好吧，伙计们，这是关于演示技巧的倒数第二课。

segments.en: As you saw, we are summarizing and concluding the presentation, and there are actually a lot of great things here to learn from, especially the vocab where you're saying, okay, let's sum things up, to wrap it up, to conclude, to summarize.
segments.zh: 正如您所看到的，我们正在总结和结束演示文稿，这里实际上有很多很棒的东西可以学习，尤其是您所说的词汇，好吧，让我们总结一下，总结，总结，总结。

segments.en: Summarize the key points, yeah. But there are also some important things coming up next week.
segments.zh: 总结要点，是的。 但下周也有一些重要的事情发生。

segments.en: That's the very, very last part of this series, because usually after a presentation, there is a section for questions and answers. That's called Q&A, and that's the topic of our next show.
segments.zh: 这就是本系列的最后一部分，因为通常在演示后，有一个部分进行问答。 这被称为问答，这是我们下一个节目的主题。

segments.en: So you guys should stay tuned for that.
segments.zh: 所以你们应该继续关注这一点。

segments.en: Alright, so we'll see you guys next time, and of course, if you have any questions or comments, you will always find us at EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们下次再见，当然，如果您有任何问题或意见，您总能在 Englishpod.com 上找到我们。

segments.en: See you guys there.
segments.zh: 在那里见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
